_doc: OECD Short-term economic statistics revisions database (DSD_STES_REVISIONS@DF_STES_REVISIONS; successor of the MEI Original Release Data and Revisions Database). Each EDITION holds the data as published in that month's Main Economic Indicators edition. CLI (LI_AA) of an edition is eligible from 'cli_public_by', the date of the earliest dated public report of that edition's CLI figures (an upper bound on the release date); where none is verified the edition month end applies. CPI (CP) of an edition is eligible only after its edition month has ended (conservative; no MEI print date is claimed). Each evidence item carries its own publication 'date'; a page lists only items published on or before its last eligible day.

method_note.text: This edition is the first produced with the OECD's revised CLI method: the double Hodrick–Prescott filter replaces the Phase Average Trend (PAT) de-trending used until November 2008, and the whole history in the vintage was re-estimated, so its levels are not comparable with earlier editions. The model scales growth by each series' own dispersion within the vintage.
